findings.issue: The shut bound is strip + shut bar + slack, read from the same layout it judges, so it grows with the bar. No check now caps how much of the phone the resting filters cover. The removed ph1 block capped the stack at 50% of PHONE_TALL. Now a shut .sectools of any height passes the absolute arm. The relative arm only catches that for the committed documents it has a row for. For a report outside the checkout or an untracked scratch render, judge() returns early with the note 'the relative arm did not run for it (the absolute bar above did)'. For those reports nothing asserts the phase outcome 'on a 390px phone the filters do not cover the table'. A shut bar covering 80% of the screen goes green. The new comment says so ('What this bound cannot see is the shut bar itself growing'), but its pointer to the relative arm does not hold for those documents.
findings.resolution: Keep the layer-derived bound and the single stackOverTable() measurement. On the same shutStack result, add a ceiling: a share of PHONE_TALL with its basis stated in the comment, e.g. the table keeps at least half of the screen it is read on. That keeps one method and still bounds the destination. If no such ceiling is wanted, judge()'s unrecorded-document notes must stop telling the reader that an absolute bar covered the document. They should say instead that the shut bar's height went unbounded on this run.

findings.issue: The diff makes this file's prose about the absolute arm false. The header says the gate 'bounds the share of a phone screen an OPEN filter panel may pin'. It says the absolute arm 'saturates — the gate scrolls a fixed distance past the bar'. It says 'the absolute arm catches the DESTINATION', and that 'The shut figure has NO absolute bar'. After this diff the absolute arm is a hit-test of what pins over the table, both shut and open, against layer-derived bounds. It no longer scrolls a fixed distance, and the shut state does have a bound. The executor reports this in its outcome, refused by the plan gate (the file is declared by P125.56-0h5), so it is disclosed, not hidden. It is still a stale claim the diff created, and it crosses the gate/relative-arm boundary this file exists to describe.
findings.resolution: Rewrite the header and the two '(the absolute bar above did)' notes in a task that owns tools/ui-checks/layout-baseline.mjs (P163.7-d6t is pending on the same file), stating the new absolute arm: one hit-test, shut and open, each bounded by the layers allowed to pin.
